These Terms apply to PlotCloud's website, browser tools and beta access. PlotCloud is the business name. Contact: {{EMAIL}}. By using the Service you agree to these Terms; do not use it if you disagree.

## 1. Testing phase and intended use
PlotCloud is in a testing/beta phase. Features, availability and results may change or contain errors. Simulation outputs support design exploration and education; they are not professional engineering advice, a building-code compliance decision or a certification. Verify important results independently. No grade, assessment outcome, admission result or professional approval is guaranteed.

## 2. Free and paid access
Sun hours and Daylight are free. Other Simulation studies and resource tools require active monthly beta access. Basic model preparation in Workspace and access to your own saved local projects and results remain available without a paid code. Third-party service costs, resource licenses and features not actually implemented are not included merely because you buy access.

## 3. Monthly price and e-transfer
The current beta price is CAD 16.99 for one calendar month, plus applicable taxes disclosed before payment. This is repeated use of the included browser tools for the stated period, not a single run. There is no automatic renewal and no automatic card charge. Each additional month is a separate order and e-transfer you choose to make.

Before sending money, email {{EMAIL}} to request complete written order details. We must confirm the seller information required for your order, total price including applicable taxes and seller-collected charges, included service, exact access dates, activation timing and cancellation/refund terms before accepting payment. Email contact does not replace any seller-address information required by law. Do not send money until these details are supplied and you accept them. Prices or conditions stated in a later order do not change an already confirmed paid period.

After written confirmation, send the agreed amount through your financial institution's e-transfer service to plotcloud@gmail.com and use the agreed order reference. Verify the recipient details, including any name displayed by your bank, against the order confirmation. Your bank may impose its own eligibility requirements, limits or fees. We do not collect banking passwords, one-time codes or security answers.

## 4. Verification, activation and expiry
Payments are reviewed manually. A claim that money was sent, a screenshot, a website account or a locally stored plan label does not activate access. After we verify receipt, we issue an activation code and written confirmation of its start and expiry dates. The paid period runs for one calendar month from the confirmed code-issue date. Contact us before paying if you need a different agreed start date.

Keep your code private and use it only for your own access. Do not resell or publish it. Access ends on the confirmed expiry date unless you order another month. We may revoke a code after a refund, fraud or a material breach of these Terms. Creating a browser-local account is not proof of a cloud account or a paid entitlement. A code may need to be re-entered on your own device after clearing browser storage. No seven-day trial is currently offered by this beta payment flow.

## 5. Fair use and third-party services
Do not scrape, automate abusive workloads, bypass access controls, interfere with other users or upload unlawful material. We may restrict access reasonably to protect the Service. Any material order-specific usage limits must be disclosed before payment. External rendering providers may require separate credentials and payment; do not assume beta access pays their charges.

## 6. Your projects and content
You retain ownership of your own projects and original work. Most browser-tool processing is local. If you enable a configured cloud account or explicitly use an external service, relevant data may be sent to that provider as described in the interface and Privacy Policy. Back up your work; browser storage can be cleared or lost. Expiry of a paid code does not itself delete your local projects or saved results.

## 7. Resources and intellectual property
PlotCloud's software, interface and original materials remain ours or their respective licensors'. Access does not transfer ownership or grant unlisted rights in third-party resources. The Resource License and any source-specific license apply. Do not redistribute protected source files, remove required credits or claim others' work as your own. Availability of a catalog record does not guarantee an attached downloadable source file.

## 8. Refunds and cancellation
The Refund Policy forms part of these Terms. There is no automatic renewal to cancel. Statutory cancellation, refund and consumer-protection rights apply and are not replaced or limited by our commercial policy. We provide the written order/receipt and access confirmation for accepted payments; retain these records.

## 9. Availability and responsibility
The beta is provided as available and may be interrupted. We do not guarantee uninterrupted use or fitness for a particular project. To the extent permitted by applicable law, we are not responsible for indirect losses, including lost data, lost profits or assessment outcomes. Nothing excludes obligations or rights that cannot lawfully be excluded, including applicable consumer remedies.

## 10. Changes and contact
We publish policy changes with an updated date. Material changes to a confirmed paid order require notice and must respect applicable law and the agreed order. For support, payment verification, privacy questions or copyright concerns, contact PlotCloud at {{EMAIL}}. We do not publish an unverified business address; any additional legally required seller details must be supplied before a paid order is accepted.

These Terms are governed by British Columbia and applicable Canadian federal law, subject to any mandatory consumer rights and dispute rights that apply where you live.
privacy:
PlotCloud uses personal information to operate its testing-phase website, respond to inquiries and manage manually verified beta access. Contact for privacy requests: {{EMAIL}}.

## Information used for beta payments
When you email us, we receive the information you include. For an e-transfer order, we use the purchaser's contact email, the agreed order details, sender information made available with the transfer, amount, payment date, reference and activation dates to match a payment, issue access, handle support and keep required records. Do not email full bank statements, banking passwords, security answers or one-time banking codes.

## Activation codes and public verification data
Keep your activation code private. The website stores a code in your browser after successful verification so you can use it again. Our public access-verification file contains only a cryptographic hash of each code, an opaque order reference and access/revocation dates; it must not contain purchaser names, emails, bank details or the code itself. The actual payment correspondence and code delivery remain private. Do not use sensitive personal information as an order reference.

## Projects and accounts
Projects and settings are stored in your browser by default. Cloud-account and project-copy features operate only where a backend is configured and you sign in. A browser-local profile is not a verified paid or cloud account. Using an external rendering or other third-party service may send content to that provider as indicated in the tool. This payment change does not itself upload your project files or enable new cloud storage. Backups should be kept before clearing browser data.

## Providers and technical data
Our website host, currently GitHub Pages, and network or content-delivery providers may process technical request information such as IP address, browser details and requested URLs under their own policies. We use Gmail for payment and support correspondence, your financial institution and applicable transfer service for e-transfer processing, and Supabase only where its account/backend features are configured. Those services may process information outside Canada. We do not receive your online-banking login through the website.

## Purposes and sharing
We use information to deliver the agreed access, verify payments, prevent misuse, resolve problems, meet recordkeeping duties and respond to lawful requests. We do not sell personal information. Optional marketing communications require your consent; payment verification emails do not subscribe you to a marketing list. We do not add advertising trackers to the beta payment flow.

## Retention and your choices
We retain payment/order records for applicable legal and accounting requirements and limit other information to operational needs. You may request access, correction or deletion by emailing {{EMAIL}}. Some records must be retained when required by law. Removing a code from your browser is not a refund request; deleting browser data does not automatically delete email or required payment records. If cloud accounts are enabled, request deletion of the cloud copy separately where the interface requires it.

## Security and changes
No storage or transmission method is risk-free. We limit unnecessary collection and never ask for banking credentials. Contact us if a code or payment message appears compromised. The published update date identifies this policy version. Any legally required seller contact details will be supplied with a paid order before payment is accepted.
